name: RC-B10-0071/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Iran's violent crackdown on protesters who took to the streets from late December 2025. It calls on Iran to stop the violence, halt executions and release detained protesters. It asks the European Union to sanction Iranian officials responsible, treat Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organisation, help Iranians get around the internet blackout, and back a democratic transition. The text is the Parliament's position and set of demands; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament demands sanctions, a terrorist listing and support for protesters.
- **Who it affects:** Iran's leaders and security forces, and Iranians facing repression.
- **What happens next:** The EU Council and Commission decide whether to act on these demands.
